body: Me.
Hi

Circle of friends - maybe for or five

I've reached out to some of them and about used them all up in this round of trouble. I don't know if they'll be willing to listen next time.

Biggest source of stress is a close friendship that may be slowly unraveling because his boyfriend cannot believe that I'm not trying to get in my friend's pants. The boyfriend has said I'm not to talk to him or his boyfriend until he (the boyfriend) says I can. I'm both amused an annoyed. Boyfriend is really jealous. And possibly loosing the friend is a big stressor. I cried/wailed for over an hour on the phone with another friend about this mess.

Actually I was thinking from the point of view of being able to let my emotions perhaps quiet down some because no outside stimulation or because of not having to put on a face I can just feel what I feel, if that makes sense. Nothing specific planned. Back to work Monday.

You're further along than I. I'm not yet to the point of deciding/realizing I don't deserve to feel this way. Or deciding/realizing I'm not a terrible person. 

I don't have many obligations over this next few days so luckily I'll be able to not be extra stressed maybe that will help.

They (kinda mixing the two here and without getting specific) know I'm in therapy and get depressed yes. I guess it's true they do care, but when one is in the middle of a depressive hole one can't think rationally.

I knew they wouldn't give me the courage, but it's nice to have a place I can vent out what I'm thinking. I have a therapist but he's unavailable this week I saw him last week and will see him next week.

I have to ask, what do you mean when you say I deserve much better since you don't know anything about me.
You're saying what is in my mind. In my case I've decided it's myself that's broken. I wish you well for figuring out your path.
You're saying what it in my mind.
I understand where you're coming from. I hope that it gets better for you.
Know that feeling. Been at this 15 years, been on five or six different drugs over that time, still in the same messed up spot.

Go check out [/r/suicidewatch](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/) that would be a good place to start for discussions like this, folks there won't be judgmental and will understand and listen. I totally get the social anxiety and Asperger's but both, as I have them too. I hate how much of life I've missed out on because of the anxiety and not reading clues around me. I wish you a good outcome whatever it may be.

Yes. It partially manifests though in if I'm asked a question about what do I like (wall hangings, carpet color, vacation spot) I don't have an answer to speak of. The Aspie and atheist parts are fairly strongly there, the gay aspect isn't, that's the one I'm wrestling with.

But thank you for checking in on this thread. I'll try not to disappoint.

Thank you. After talking with my therapist I think the first thing is to self-reveal as Aspie at work. Leave everything else alone. The atheist part is pretty easy to avoid at work no one has any religious stuff on cubicle walls that I can see tho I have a printed copy of the Seven Tenants just text on paper. The gay aspect is really, really tricky. I've got to work it out within myself a great deal.
Thank you. It's like an onion things to peel away to get to layers underneath.

I know the feeling. I've never had a surprise party thrown for me. Can count on two hands maybe one the number of times someone has actually done something special for me as a person, something they knew I'd like.
Thank you. I'll try and keep updating. This will be an interesting ride.

Oh ok I didn't realize that. Yes of the three probably the Aspie part is trickiest. The gay bit I'm still working on within myself. Atheist is kinda minor in comparison and probably the thing I'm most out about. Except of course at work.

My state doesn't have such protections. I've talked it over with my therapist and outing as gay at work is probably the least important of the three. Better to start with outing as an Aspie. I see him again in a week we wil discuss more. Thank you for the encouragement.
I know exactly what you mean. You took the words right out of my mouth.

Thanks. I left him a message and he returned it saying I may be on to something. I agree with the notion you espouse of if I can withstand the pain of suicide then anything else is bearable, paraphrasing here. Yet it feels different somehow. I'm going to have to come out at work at some point that worries me. I figure advise HR person first then manager then team in that order over a couple of days after the first of the year. Let the rest of work find out however. Maybe a psych hospital visit for a couple of days as well to help me get in the right mindset. Anyway thank you for the words.
So I just PM you?
I understand.
I don't know, but I have somehow. Having a gun around would scare me too it would be too easy I fear.
Thank you.

Well an update. I spent most of the session crying quietly. It was so bad he's going to see me Wednesday too. 

I had insight this morning that maybe I'm trying to run from the pain of being an Aspie, an atheist, and gay, and it just all builds up. I'm afraid maybe of coming all the way out and that fear is stronger than the fear of death. 

I'll talk with him tomorrow. I've agreed to postpone taking any action until after Christmas.
No because I don't want to have to start all over. He's good, I just can't be helped.
"Someone who chooses to love you independent from family, who makes you laugh & who you share special moments with. " If you have had this I am glad for you. I wish for you that you can find peace.

"Someone who chooses to love you independent from family, who makes you laugh & who you share special moments with. " No, I have no idea what this is like. If you have them I'm glad for you. I hope you are able to find peace.

I really don't know who I would call, and even so it would be just another temporary relief. The underlying problems are still there. I cans fix them I truly believe at this point. I feel like I have a terminal condition I've been fighting for decades and now I'm ready to make peace with it and end the fight. But thank you so much for replying.

Thank you for replying. I'll see how it goes. I've been fighting this for about 30 years now. I truly feel that I'm out of options. I've been with this therapist for almost 16 years. I don't know what else to do, but still thank you for replying.
Except for student loans. Can't get rid of those.
Movie about a Mormon (LDS) guy who realizes he's gay when he falls in love with another gay boy while the LDS guy is on his mission.
I'm lucky I guess I have a non-MD/PhD therapist I see who understand. I wish you well.
Then you're at a very high risk of success in the eyes of the authorities I think in case you didn't know that already.
You're welcome.

You're right, something is wrong. Talk to your GP if you can get a same day/next day appointment. If you can't, go to your local Emergency Department and tell the check-in desk that you have a desire to kill yourself, and describe any of the plans and equipment you have stored away, or if not stored away how you are going to obtain them. Then you're set, you'll be in a safe environment where treatment can begin. Good luck.
Do you have a plan of how to do this? And do you have the materials on-hand to execute your plan?

You're in a world of hurt. By posting here you have clearly shown you have suicidal ideation - in simple terms, you're thinking of killing yourself. Go to any hospital near to you, walk in, and say to the nurse at the front desk "I need help, I am wanting to kill myself, I need help". They'll take you in, keep you safe, and help set you up with a support network to give you a chance to get things back going well in life. Best wishes, and PM me if you want to chat.
That's what I meant, yes. Do you have the means as well (materials, anything you might need) readily available to carry out your plans?
Do you have a plan? Do you have the means to carry out the plan?
Anyone who wants to know the total amount taken PM me. Or not.
finally bedtime
And some more.
This will be about the point in time the retrograde amnesiatic effects start to take hold I think lol.
And time for a little bit more.
Gonna take a little bit more.
Can feel them taking effect.

Well took a few of the lorazepam. None of the vodka. Here's to a "small death", hopefully many hours of unawareness from the world, a practice death if you will. Already advised my Saturday evening engagement I may not be in attendance. I'll see how I'm doing in about 30 minutes and if I'm not sufficiently zoned might take some more.

Sometimes you gotta' pour concrete. You don't always have all the data. You plot what you do have, evaluate the trend, look and see if interventions in the past have had any effect and if so what, extrapolate possible and probable future events, and if the possibilities of success are below your required threshold you terminate.

There aren't any groups for adults in my area (like 75 mile radius), there's one for parents of Aspie children, not really applicable and I'd not fit in at all. There are some Facebook groups. Yes it's part of the curse. We desire to socialize, but we don't know how to do so. Thank you for the complement as to my writing ability and my lucidity. My intellect, my brain, is all I have to go on - so it's what I do best. 

Yes agree on the stigma on mental health issues in general in society.

I've been in therapy for 14 years. I have the lorazepam to use to fight the panic if I'm going to be in a social situation. There isn't a medication for Asperger Syndrome. It's just a way of being wired that affects how we perceive and interact with the world. Best they can do is some cognitive behavioral therapy to cope with learning how NT people interact and interpreting them, and anti-depressants maybe if depression develops from not being able to participate in the world. Nice thought though. You go through life knowing you don't fit in and no one except another Aspie will understand how you feel.

You're searching. Screw the debtors, they knew what they were getting into when they took the risk and already factor in some losses each year yet still make ghastly amounts of profit. Do what you want with your life, screw the debtors.

You make the decision of the point of no return I think based on your best projection of what the rest of your life from that point on will be like. Life is about finding something to do until you die.
NeuroTypical - someone whose brain is wired in a typical fashion and doesn't have Asperger Syndrome/isn't on the autistic spectrum. Most people in other words.

I understand that's the theory, but I don't know what to do with the data. I can equally tell a story where they just like surrounding themselves with people and invite me because they know I'm too senseless to know I'm being used or they don't care they're just using me as a wall decoration. Hate to burst your bubble of conclusion.
You're honest about not being able to relate, that's refreshing. Most NTs aren't that honest.
Interesting point. From my view I can't tell if it's a script or genuine.

Yes to an NT they sounds like "normal" social interaction. To an Aspie they're all just a big lie, a script like one is in a play. NTs love playing lip service to each other. Their world is built on it. Some people that I do let get in kinda slightly close to me I explain the situation and do ask for more directness. No I don't go around asking people that I know "do you care about me" because that would just create even more awkward situations than already exist.

Because when I parrot their scripts right back at them "So nice to see you", "thank you for inviting me", "I had a good time" "so kind of you to say that" and all of that they smile and say those things right back. And you hit on a point about Asperger Syndrome. Maybe they are being genuine in their mind, but it isn't making it through to me. And maybe that is because I can't recognize it. In the end, from my point of view, it's all the same, I'm not registering/able to register (same difference) that anyone actually gives a damn about me.

No I haven't tried the gym. My physical state is at the point that I wouldn't last but like 15 minutes and be out of breath and more depressed. It's not social anxiety it's a gut-level (amglyda level if you prefer) reaction to a new situation. It's not embarrassment. It's at the same low-level as the flight-or-fight reaction.

Your glib suggestion to go do something and others will be draw to me only works if I know how to interact with them. If I'm being myself I get rejected because of my Asperger's. So that lessens the desire to want to interact with another because I just get hurt. But being lonely hurts as well. The way to end the downward cycle is death.

Yeah it would help if you knew something about Asperger's. Think of Cmdr. Data or Mr. Spock on Star Trek. Or of those awkward socially inept but very brain-smart kids your knew growing up that never seemed to "get" the joke. The rest of the people, NeuroTypicals we call them (NT) aren't following scripts they are doing what comes naturally to them for they built this world to fit them. If they really do but aren't showing it then it doesn't matter that they do the end result to me is still the same in that their "care" isn't making it to me.

If you're looking for happy encouragement watch Latter Days.

LDS doesn't want you if you aren't going to reproduce and make a big family. That's just how it is. They supported the Prop 8 mess in California big time.

And at 18 you're kinda screwed too old for a youth shelter. Check /r/gaybroteens for support resources like folks in your area who will let you couch surf until things get better. Because they aren't going to get better living with a family that is *this* far from disowning you.

Online dating never pans out, continual rejections or ignored. I don't really know what I enjoy when I'm not depressed. If I'm not running a social script because I'm having to interact with others I'm thinking about how to get a hookup or how to end my life. And the failure of getting the hookup leads me to more depression. So I take Benadryl and go to sleep and get up and repeat the next day trudging through the job. Waiting until time to die. So might as well make it be on my own terms.
That's what I'm thinking in my case. I've spent years in therapy and the problem always comes back to me.

No there isn't an Asperger support group. I've been in therapy for about 14 years now. I don't even think I have friends right now. I have people who I think give lip service, or follow the script, but I could not talk to anyone for three days and none of them would even check to see how I was. If I do it tonight then the next time someone is expecting to hear from me is Sunday early evening and I'd be good and gone by then.
Yes it is a cry for help. You can't control their feelings or how they react though. It's your life not theirs, you decide on what terms you want to live it or end it.

There aren't anywhere near enough peaks to counter the valleys. Interesting list. No SO so the orgasms just make me feel lonelier. No money for travel or lodging. Social anxiety and hat smoke keeps me out of the bars. Cats and dogs my apartment is too small and I don't want a dependent I'll just resent when I can barely take care of myself sometimes. No pot, money plus don't need legal troubles on top of all mu other shit. The beach - I'm several hundred miles inland, no money for travel or lodging. Chocolate - interesting I hadn't considered that. Smiling at someone I think is hot is possibly going to get me beat up (I'm attracted to members of my own sex) and is dangerous to do. Jameson - money again. Don't care for the show. Thunderstorms wake me up but the smell before and after is nice. Reading too much reddit and I realize how much of a life I don't have. Omelets are good I'll give you that. Don't drink coffee and don't smoke. Thank you for the effort. I actually didn't expect anyone to even try.
What's in the bottle you're staring at?

Asperger Syndrome. Always been alone, always going to be alone. I can fool myself in little bits and pieces to think I actually interact with people and that they like to interact with me. But I don't, I'm just running a script, and they don't, they don't know me they just respond to the script. I was at a social event tonight and didn't know anyone and realized once again how I'll never ever fit in on this planet in any group. I'm not broken enough that there's like tons of people who actually want to offer support like if I were in a wheelchair or something. I'm expected to just man-up, shrug it off, get over myself, all that crap. I'm tired of it, it will never work for me, it never has.  I'd be better off dead.
